method: Manual image picks in original image pixels; a single global similarity maps Google screenshot pixels into the georeferenced Esri pixel grid. No local warps. Water-colour centroids are approximate image landmarks, not surveyed pool centres.

waterCentroids.method: trace_pools.components on RGB source with the existing is_water colour threshold; largest component in each window. Shadow/plant exclusions bias centroids. No model vertices used in extraction. Windows [left,top,right,bottom]. Main pool excluded because threshold separates its shadowed water into multiple components.

limits: All roof picks about 0.7–1.2 m; visible roof parapets and projecting balconies are not proven ground walls. Water picks about 0.5 m. No ground survey, camera calibration, source capture dates or independent absolute checkpoints are available. The Google standard screenshot and Apple 3D views are qualitative only.
